source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: This ability has two parts. First: on declaring a charge with this unit while an enemy CHARACTER unit lies within 12" of it, you may choose to use this part; if you do, the unit may re-roll the Charge roll, but it has to finish its charge move engaged with at least one such enemy CHARACTER unit. Second, usable once per battle across your whole army: during the Fight phase, as this unit is picked to fight while a CHARACTER unit is engaged with it, you may give its melee attacks [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] for the rest of that phase.
